title: Topology Hub Optimal Transport: Eliminating Long Context Dilution at Flash Speed
abstract: arXiv:2611.27951v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context models use sparse or structured attention to avoid quadratic cost, yet retrieving a small set of relevant facts embedded among hundreds of thousands of distractors degrades as normalization mass disperses with length. Hub-and-spoke optimal transport (OT) replaces the dense $L \times L$ matrix with a linear-size graph over local windows and $K$ shared hubs balanced by Sinkhorn scaling. Building on block-wise tail refinement and fixed-support transport topology (arXiv:2605.08123, arXiv:2609.07954), we introduce Topology Hub Optimal Transport (THOT): (1) bounded-support capacity gating via simplex sparsemax ($O(L\log L)$) or sorting-free token-local thresholded ReLU ($O(L)$), driving excess distractor mass to zero; (2) a three-sweep $1+2$ annealed row-closed Sinkhorn schedule that damps bipartite residuals; (3) an exact rank-$(D+2R+1)$ One-Reference-Tile adjoint in batched split-factor Triton kernels (BF16 Tensor Cores, FP32 po

translated_title: 拓扑枢纽最优传输：以闪速消除长上下文稀释
translated_abstract: 长上下文模型通常采用稀疏或结构化注意力机制来避免二次方复杂度的开销，然而当归一化质量随序列长度增加而分散时，从数十万条干扰信息中检索出少量相关事实的能力会随之退化。轮辐式最优传输（OT）用由局部窗口和 K 个共享枢纽构成的线性规模图替代稠密的 L×L 矩阵，并通过 Sinkhorn 缩放实现平衡。在分块尾部细化与固定支撑传输拓扑（arXiv:2605.08123, arXiv:2609.07954）的基础上，我们提出了拓扑枢纽最优传输（THOT）：（1）通过单纯形 sparsemax（O(L log L)）或无需排序的词元局部阈值化 ReLU（O(L)）实现有界支撑的容量门控，将多余的干扰质量驱动至零；（2）一种三遍扫掠的 1+2 退火行封闭 Sinkhorn 调度方案，用于抑制二部图残差；（3）在批量分裂因子 Triton 内核（BF16 Tensor Core，FP32 po……原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: THOT 提出一种基于轮辐式拓扑的最优传输注意力机制，通过有界支撑容量门控、退火行封闭 Sinkhorn 调度和高效 Triton 内核伴随计算，以接近 FlashAttention 的速度消除长上下文中的注意力质量稀释问题。
en_tdlr: THOT introduces a hub-and-spoke optimal transport attention mechanism that eliminates long-context dilution at FlashAttention-like speed via bounded-support capacity gating, an annealed row-closed Sinkhorn schedule, and exact adjoint computation in efficient Triton kernels.
